title: Estée Lauder Companies raises FY27 outlook amid Q1 sales boost driven by fragrance
summary: Net sales at the Estée Lauder Companies soared 7% to $3.7 billion during fiscal Q1 2027, as fragrance, skin care and make-up revenue increased across the board thanks to the giant’s ‘Beauty Reimagined’ plan

title: Henkel UK&I bets on gloss treatments as hair care’s next big growth category
summary: With the hair gloss category’s value up 21% in the UK this year, Henkel Consumer Brands UK & Ireland is investing heavily in the low-maintenance, wash-out colour format via its Schwarzkopf’s Live brand, calling it the ‘most dynamic segment within colourants’

title: Exclusive: Lookfantastic ambassador Molly-Mae Hague launches first curated collection
summary: Lookfantastic has partnered with long-term collaborator, influencer and entrepreneur, Molly-Mae Hague, to launch an exclusive edit of her favourite beauty products for the first time

title: E.l.f. Brands opts for ‘handcrafted’ stop motion Christmas campaign instead of AI
summary: The beauty company’s 60-second ‘e.l.f. Made to Stand Out’ 2026 Christmas campaign has been created using stop motion filmmaking techniques to celebrate ‘human creativity’ and is narrated by Tony Award-winning actor Alan Cumming

title: Kenvue hails overall bump in Q3 2026 results despite mixed beauty sales
summary: Despite Kenvue’s Q3 2026 net sales rising 3.2% to $3.8 billion, the Johnson & Johnson (J&J) spinoff consumer health company’s skin health and beauty sales division only saw sales increase by 0.1%

title: Hailey Bieber’s Rhode unveils $5 million grant and partnership with Foundation for Women’s Health
summary: The beauty brand’s $5 million grant will help advance women’s health research and innovation via Rhode’s Futures Fund, which forms part of parent company e.l.f. Beauty’s commitment to give away 2% of its profits to meaningful causes

title: Estée Lauder Companies partners with Microsoft to boost AI capabilities
summary: The move forms part of the Estée Lauder Companies’ efforts to bring together its global operations under a single operating model, and will advance the MAC Cosmetics and Clinique owner’s artificial intelligence, cloud and data capabilities

title: Luneia Brands brings K-beauty to Selfridges through Medicube and Biodance counters
summary: UK beauty distributor Luneia Brands will unveil permanent standalone counters for Korean skin care giants Biodance and Medicube as luxury department store Selfridges opens its new dedicated K-beauty destination

title: Exclusive: Croda, Azelis and Brenntag identified as top 3 cosmetic ingredient suppliers in AI search report
summary: A new GEO-focused Visibility Index Report, based on ChatGTP conversations, revealed how distributors are mostly likely to score highest in unbranded AI searches

title: Reminiscing on a magical evening at the Pure Beauty Awards 2026
summary: Some evenings stay with you long after the lights go down, and the 2026 Pure Beauty Awards was certainly one of them

title: Maria Galland Paris and Revieve Launch [SKIN]ALYZE PRO across seven european markets
summary: Building on Maria Galland Paris’ longstanding Skin Intelligence and professional skin care expertise, the AI-powered Skin Advisor takes this signature approach further, translating individual skin analysis into personalised product recommendations and tailored skin care rituals

title: CMS CONSULTING: Combining precision, quality and social responsibility in cosmetic packaging
summary: Czech-based CMS CONSULTING offers flexible, high-quality secondary packaging and assembly solutions for the cosmetics industry, combining specialist expertise with a strong commitment to sustainability and inclusive employment

title: LipoTrue introduces three new biotechnological actives: Glintarine, Red Aternaliss and Kalizyme
summary: Together, the three launches reflect LipoTrue’s commitment to precise, innovative and nature-inspired cosmetic biotechnology. Each ingredient approaches skin performance from a different biological perspective, while sharing the same objective: to translate advanced science into effective solutions for modern cosmetic formulations
